status: proposed-contract; additive amendment of the 1.3.0 audit-read availability field; the 1.3.0 bytes stay frozen; no activation, deployment or host support claimed

meanings.producer_unavailable: Processing is disabled. Events are not being produced.
meanings.producer_not_enqueuing: Processing is on but enqueueing is off. New events are not being queued.
meanings.producer_starting: Enabled, but the runner has not run yet.
meanings.producer_stale: The runner has not run for 5 minutes.
meanings.producer_degraded: The last run hit transient errors, or this site has a job held as processor_unavailable.
meanings.producer_active: The runner is running normally. Only this code lets an empty history be read as no events.

availability.emptyHistory: Only producer_active supports reading an empty page as no events or no episodes. Every other code means events may be missing or delayed. No code makes an empty page a zero count of site issues.
availability.supersedes: In 1.3.0 producer_unavailable was the only allowed value. Under 1.4.0 the codes above are allowed. 1.3.0 validators are unchanged and still reject the new codes.

events.held_by_reason: object of reason string to integer >= 0
events.counts_capped: boolean; true makes pending and held lower bounds

producer.note: The object describes the producer, not the history. It carries no other owner's data. Hosts must not infer an empty history from it.

consistency: producer_unavailable requires processing_enabled false (events) or operations_enabled false (episodes)
producer_not_enqueuing requires processing_enabled true and enqueue_enabled false
producer_starting requires processing_enabled, enqueue_enabled and last_run_at null
producer_stale, producer_degraded and producer_active require processing_enabled, enqueue_enabled and a non-null last_run_at
producer_active requires last_outcome not retry and no held job with reason processor_unavailable
gates: exact-head contract review and canonical merge
H15 producer/processor activation is independently gated
three host source/readiness companions at exact canonical merge; runtime support separately verified
